summary: Destroys a texture-surface container, consistent with the ABI lead Texture_Surface_Destroyer. If the entry count at this+0 is positive, iterates the active entries in the block at this+4 with a 36-byte (0x24) stride calling ArrayBlockCleanup on each. Then unconditionally clears the count at this+0. If the block pointer at this+4 is non-null, reads the allocation capacity from the header at block-4, walks all 36-byte (0x24) slots in reverse calling ArrayBlockCleanup per slot and freeing the sub-pointers at slot+0x18 and slot+0x0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf, frees the block header itself, and finally zeroes this+4. Returns the result of the last free operation. Called by SessionReset and TireBrandLoader during teardown.

local_names.v6: allocation capacity read from the header at block-4
local_names.v7: block header address (block-4) passed to FreeWrapper_7bcf
local_names.v10: slot pointer walked in reverse through the block

operations.description: Guard (this+0 > 0): if the entry count at this+0 is positive, the active-entries loop runs.
Iterates v4 = 0..count-1 calling ArrayBlockCleanup on each active entry at this[1] + v4 with a 36-byte (0x24) stride.
Reads the block pointer this[1] (this+4), then clears the entry count at this+0 to 0 unconditionally.

If the saved block pointer is non-null: reads the allocation capacity at block-4, computes the full block span (capacity * 36 bytes), and walks the 36-byte (0x24) slots in reverse, calling ArrayBlockCleanup per slot and freeing the sub-pointer at slot+0x18 (if set) and at slot+0x0 (if set) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Frees the block header at block-4 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Zeroes the block pointer field at this+4 (this[1] = 0).
Returns the result of the last free operation (or the last-read count if the block pointer was null).
